TYPE CHECK: The candidate value consists of organs/tissues, which matches the definition of the field.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper states that adult nematodes were isolated from the "eye" and microfilariae (mfs) were collected from the "skin"; however, the actual MS sample was derived specifically from "proteins extracted from an adult female of O. lupi" (which came from the eye).
TRUTH CHECK: The MS analysis was performed on proteins from an adult female worm isolated from the eye. There is no mention of MS analysis being performed on the skin-derived microfilariae.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set includes "skin", which is not the source of the MS sample.
